eyebrow: A PRAYER SERIES ON STARTING OVER
coverTitle:
Five Prayers
For Starting Over
When You Didn't Plan To
coverDek: For the new job, the new city, the new normal after a loss or a diagnosis or an ending you didn't choose — five prayers for the ground under your first few steps again.

points.hook: Lord, I didn't choose this chapter, but here I am starting it anyway.
paragraphs: I didn't ask for the ending that put me here — the job that let me go, the marriage that didn't make it, the diagnosis that rewrote my whole calendar. But morning still came, and so did I. Lord, give me grace for a beginning I never asked for, and the strength to stop measuring it against the one I planned.
points.verseText: Behold, I will do a new thing; now it shall spring forth; shall ye not know it? I will even make a way in the wilderness, and rivers in the desert.

points.hook: I decree: this new beginning is not a demotion — it is a door.
paragraphs: I decree over this new season: it is not a step down, it is a door opening, in the name of Jesus! Whatever ended did not disqualify me — it only cleared the ground. What I rebuild from here will carry more of God's fingerprints than what I lost, in Jesus' mighty name!
points.verseText: Old things are passed away; behold, all things are become new.

points.hook: Notice how tired starting over makes your whole body feel before you've even started.
paragraphs: Notice the exhaustion that shows up before the first step even happens — the tight chest packing boxes again, the heavy legs walking into a room full of strangers, the shallow breath filling out the same forms you thought you were finally done with. Lord, this body has been carrying a beginning it never rehearsed for. Steady it, one breath at a time.
points.verseText: He giveth power to the faint; and to them that have no might he increaseth strength.

points.hook: Somebody in this family is quietly starting over and hoping nobody asks too many questions.
paragraphs: Somebody here is rebuilding a life this month and hasn't told the whole story yet — a new apartment, a new routine, a new version of normal nobody warned them to prepare for. Family, don't wait for the headline before you check in. Ask the quiet one how the new chapter is actually going, and sit with whatever answer comes back.
points.verseText: And let us consider one another to provoke unto love and to good works.

points.hook: Child, I was already in the new place before you ever packed a box.
paragraphs: Child, I was already in the new place before you packed the first box, already in the new job before your first day, already awake in the new normal before you opened your eyes to it. You are not walking into this alone, and you are not starting from nothing — you are starting from Me, and I never left.
points.verseText: For I know the thoughts that I think toward you, saith the LORD, thoughts of peace, and not of evil, to give you an expected end.

cta.closingLine: If you're starting over this season, you're not behind — you're beginning. Come back tomorrow for the next series.
